title: Lincoln Hills Fly Fishing Club
specs: Nearly two miles of private river on South Boulder Creek with catch and release fishing
5 acre Pactolus Lake and three spring fed ponds with large wary trout
Boulder River Ranch offers a one mile stretch of river and 5 ponds with large feisty trout
Singing River Ranch on Upper Bear Creek with wild brown trout and occasional 3-pound rainbow
blurb: Lincoln Hills Fly Fishing Club offers private fly fishing preserves including South Boulder Creek, Boulder River Ranch, and Singing River Ranch. These preserves feature trout fishing in clear waters with opportunities for dry fly fishing and catching multiple trout species. Membership is by invitation only and focused on preserving a high-quality fishing experience.
